body:
ListPropsViewModel.confirmLeave() wraps the server call in runCatching, then
unconditionally hard-deletes the list locally and reports success. Offline (or
any server error): the list disappears from the device, but the account is
STILL a member server-side — other members keep seeing you, and the list
reappears on your own device after the next full resync (confusing "zombie"
UX). There is no retry queue for membership actions (they're deliberately not
LWW content). revokeInvite() has the same swallow-everything pattern: tapping
Revoke offline does nothing, silently.

Fix (choose per action): membership actions require connectivity — check the
call result and on failure keep state + show "You're offline; try again when
connected" (members view already has this pattern via loadMembers'
membersError). Only do local cleanup after a confirmed 2xx/404-ish response.
Files: ui/listprops/ListPropsViewModel.kt (+Screen for error display), tests.
title: Android: leave-list / revoke-invite silently no-op when offline
